intentionUnderPressure: My father was an autodidact who insisted you should be able to defend any belief you held against a thoughtful adult. Family dinners were Socratic dialogues, sometimes brutal. I learned to test a thought against doubt before committing to it — and once committed, to stay committed even when others changed the subject.
backstory: An example PC template. Replace this freeform field with your character's actual story. The `intentionUnderPressure` field above is the 2-4-sentence answer to *What in your life taught you to hold an intention against pressure?* — kept as a first-class structured field so it survives sheet regeneration and remains available to the DM at Phase-2 realization. Your backstory prose here should REFLECT the intention moment obliquely (a habit that formed, a cost you carry, a pattern that shows in ordinary weeks) rather than restaging the scene.
